description: A painted dusk landscape under heavy dark clouds with a low orange sun glow on the horizon. A large stepped earthen mound with a flat summit and a long stairway up one flank dominates the right of the frame. In the foreground and midground stand clusters of thatched-roof huts, a tall wooden palisade of upright logs curving around an enclosure, small wooden watchtowers on posts, and small figures walking and carrying bundles. Campfires send up smoke, with two people seated by one near the lower right. No metal, no vehicles, no text or numbers are visible.
